notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cacophodon, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Cacophodon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cacophodon enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, dealing damage equal to Cacophodon's power to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
